run_draw_zones: run the interactive polygon drawing tool on an image or video to create zone annotations
create_resolve_source: create a function that loads an image or extracts the first frame from a video file
save_polygons_to_json: save drawn polygon coordinates to a JSON configuration file
test_close_and_finalize_polygon: test closing and finalizing the current polygon with a filled shape
review_redraw_polygons: review the function that redraws all finalized polygon outlines on the image
